Schnittstelle Pred<A>

Typparameter:
A - the input type checked by this predicate
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Predicate<A>
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
MemoisingPred<A>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Pred<A> extends Predicate<A>

A functional interface describing a boolean condition over values of type A.

Extends the standard Predicate with additional logical combinators such as NAND, NOR, and XOR, and provides utilities for composing predicates via methods like and, or, and negate.

Contract: inputs must not be null. Combinators use short‑circuit evaluation where applicable (e.g., and, or).

Seit:
1.0.0

    • alwaysTrue

      static <A> Pred<A> alwaysTrue()

      Returns a predicate that always yields true, regardless of the input value.

      Contract: the input must not be null. A NullPointerException is thrown if a null input is provided.

      Typparameter:
      A - the input type accepted by the predicate
      Gibt zurück:
      a predicate that always returns true
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if the input is null

      @SafeVarargs static <A> Pred<A> and(@NonNull Pred<A> first, @NonNull Pred<A> second, @NonNull Pred<A>... others)

      Returns the logical conjunction of all provided predicates: first AND second AND ... others.

      Contract: all predicates must not be null. Short‑circuits from left to right.

      Parameter:
      first - the first predicate; must not be null

      Löst aus:

    • xor

      @SafeVarargs static <A> Pred<A> xor(@NonNull Pred<A> first, @NonNull Pred<A> second, @NonNull Pred<A>... others)

      Returns the exclusive OR of all provided predicates, implemented as a left‑to‑right fold of XOR: (((first XOR second) XOR ...) XOR others[n]).

      Contract: all predicates must not be null.

      Typparameter:
      A - the input type
      Parameter:
      first - the first predicate; must not be null
      second - the second predicate; must not be null
      others - additional predicates; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the XOR combination of all predicates
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any predicate array or element is null
      Seit:

      default @NonNull Pred<A> and(@NonNull Pred<A> other)
